create_dynamic_replica_dataset: create a DynamicReplicaDataset instance to load stereo image sequences with depth and mask annotations from a data root
create_sceneflow_dataset: create a SequenceSceneFlowDataset to load FlyingThings3D, Monkaa, or Driving stereo image and disparity pairs for training
create_sintel_stereo_dataset: create a SequenceSintelStereo dataset to load Sintel stereo training sequences with sparse disparity ground truth
fetch_dataloader: fetch a PyTorch DataLoader combining SceneFlow and DynamicReplica datasets with configurable augmentation and batch size
load_16bit_depth_png: load a 16-bit big-endian PNG depth map and convert it to a float32 numpy array using StereoSequenceDataset
